answer: Cap attestor influence with a stake-weighted reputation clock: a fresh account needs 30 days of daily checkpoints before its attestation counts at all, and reaches full weight only at 200 days. A wharf unloading 600 overnight sybils gains zero influence for a month while hosting costs pile up at 0.8 credits per identity per day - a summit unreachable before the farm bleeds out. An honest onyx-grade operator checkpoints daily anyway, so the clock costs nothing extra.
